title: Amanda Connor
description:
"STAR WARS came out when I was thirteen. I was one of those kids that blew all my allowance on going to see the movie again and again. I saw it at least 22 times."

"I heard Chewbacca is a great mechanic. Maybe on his home planet he has a shop or a service station. If so, it might look something like this!"

FUN FACT: "My parents used to know Harrison Ford when he was a carpenter. He and my dad pulled, like, 6,000,000 nails from an old floor at our house. We still have his old miter box."

- Amanda Conner
